- **Incident Details:** Date, time, and precise location of the collision, along with weather, road conditions, and visibility at the scene.
- **Parties & Vehicles Involved:** Names, contact information, driver’s license numbers, insurance details, and vehicle descriptions (make, model, year, license plate) for all drivers, plus any passengers or witnesses.
- **Narrative & Diagram:** A factual, chronological account of events leading up to the crash, point of impact, damages sustained, injuries reported, and a sketch showing vehicle positions, traffic controls, and relevant landmarks.
